associated_5FS_scale_sensitivity.definition: standard 7-point LO scale sensitivity; muR,muF in {350,700,1400} GeV, ratios 1/4 and 4 excluded

associated_5FS_scale_sensitivity.interpretation: LO sensitivity only; not calibrated NLO uncertainty or a confidence interval

evolved_Yukawa_correlated_3point.definition: correlated-3-point LO sensitivity with D4 one-loop Yukawa masses evolved to muR; central run is exactly shared with frozen700 scheme
evolved_Yukawa_correlated_3point.mass_evolution: Frozen Module7 D4 running_mass/yukawa_masses using alpha_s(MZ)=0.118; independent of LO PDF alpha_s=0.130 scheme; no silent scheme replacement

limitations: Exactly the validated D5 P1 Z-only and P2 5FS LO reference outputs; no new MG5 execution.
Quoted errors are numerical integration only, not theory/PDF uncertainties.
The mixed-pair P1 is Z-only; full-model diagrams and interference remain uncalculated.
No physical Zee global viability, LHC limit, acceptance, detector or background claim.
D4 BRs are on-shell tree two-body and their uncertainties are not assessed.

diagram_classes.explanation: Generated photon graph has numerically zero mixed coupling (native residual <=5.56e-17). Z is the only appreciable gauge graph. hh1/hh2/Ah2 and CKM quark exchange retained, including flavor-changing initial pairs. Six diagrams for unequal initial flavors, eight for identical flavors. No gg loop-induced production or QCD overlap.
